g.text: Jev's confidence versus its actual mistakes
Native confidence and selected-answer probability are different outputs.
A curve further left means lower scores. Separation shows whether the score helps rank mistakes.
A native confidence of 0.9 does not itself mean a 90% chance of being right. No fitted calibration was used.
